title: [Shopify] Rename tax matching and add configurable processing limit
summary: Customer-facing references to Shopify Tax Matching Agent now read Shopify Tax Matching, and AL object names stay unchanged. A new fail-closed, per-company rolling order limit is configured through the ShopifyTaxMatchingProcessingLimit Azure Key Vault value, and new telemetry covers configuration problems and limit exhaustion.
key_points: Renamed customer-facing references from 'Shopify Tax Matching Agent' to 'Shopify Tax Matching' while keeping internal AL object names unchanged
Implemented a fail-closed, per-company rolling order limit configurable via Azure Key Vault setting ShopifyTaxMatchingProcessingLimit
Extended operational telemetry to track configuration issues, limit exhaustion, request volume, and matching results
Added deterministic AL tests covering configuration parsing, fail-closed behavior, limit enforcement, and rolling-period expiry
Updated Learn More action to point to the Microsoft Learn article for the feature
